  1. Open on the game?

    The landing waits.

  2. Hide a chapter until you scroll there?

    No. Any chapter is open.

  3. Count the team on Fortress?

  4. Use Lumi as the campus cat?

    A separate black cat. The video starts muted.

  5. Only a Next chapter button?

    Also a floor pad. The button stays. The last chapter has no pad.

  6. Play music on arrival?

    Silent until a chapter has been opened.

  7. Separate songs for the closet and the cubicle?

    They share one track. It does not restart.

    College.
